scope: Current catalogue after Phase 1 source and photo safeguards; unavailable is explicit and does not mean researched content is complete.
yearPolicy: A source year is the identified specification year, not an inferred production range or publication date. Null means unknown.

photoPolicy.providers: Wikimedia Commons records with CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0, public-domain metadata or an individually checked attribution-only permission. Manufacturer material remains excluded until applicable permission is established.
photoPolicy.matching: Generation/body references retain trim/year/market differences. Engine-family references identify the actual photographed subject and remain exact-application research tasks.
photoPolicy.note: Fourteen additional Commons engine/drive references were downloaded, inspected, resized and converted to WebP with credits preserved. No AI photographs are used.
